t0522: In Note G from 1843, Ada described a procedure for calculating Bernoulli numbers using the Analytical Engine. It is often cited as the first published computer program. However, the machine was not completed during her lifetime. The name “Bernoulli.exe” is our joke - file extensions were certainly not on the agenda back then.
